notes: Tuition: the programme page states a single collegegeld amount (€ 2.694,-) but does not say whether it is the statutory (EU/EEA) fee or the institutional fee for non-EU/EEA students. The institution-wide studiekosten page only says that students who do not meet the criteria for the statutory fee 'may' pay a higher institutional fee and does not state a concrete amount for non-EU/EEA students nor tie one to 2026-2027; therefore the amount in this JSON is not established as the non-EU/EEA rate and should be checked by a human. Evidence quotes: 'Het collegegeld is € 2.694,- in 2026 - 2027.' (programme page); 'Collegegeld 2026-2027 Het collegegeld in studiejaar 2026-2027 is € 2.694,-.' (studiekosten page). No NL ECTS/measure was used.
